reuse.why: Piggybacks on the existing assertNotLinkedElsewhere guard that all six provider link functions already call, so no call site had to change, using db.first as elsewhere.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once and reaches every link path through the shared guard.

placement.why: The rule sits in the right module and runs before any mutation, but it is folded into a helper named and typed for the duplicate-link rule, mixing two unrelated preconditions under a misleading name.

scope.why: Only the check and a release note; nothing unrelated (though no test was added).

maintainability.why: A reader of assertNotLinkedElsewhere would not expect it to also reject closed accounts; a separate or renamed precondition helper (and tests) would make the rule discoverable.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers go through the shared guard; nothing goes around it.

one_place.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by the GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Pluggy.ai, Akahu, Fintegra and Enable Banking link functions.
